ai_compatibility.nvidia: CUDA has the broadest Windows ecosystem coverage for PyTorch and common local AI tooling.
ai_compatibility.amd: ROCm 7.2.1 Windows 11 matrix lists RX 9070/RX 9070 XT for PyTorch 2.9 with Python 3.12, but Windows currently supports only PyTorch, no ML training support, and not the full ROCm stack. Linux has broader support.
ai_compatibility.implication: If local ML training or CUDA-specific tools on Windows are important, prioritize NVIDIA. If AI is mainly cloud/API use and WQHD gaming/power efficiency dominate, RX 9070 becomes more attractive.

performance_and_power.efficiency_note: Do not divide FPS from Tom's Hardware by power from a different review and present it as a measured FPS/W result. Exact same-review board power/FPS pairs are not available for all candidates today.
